content5.ptxt: The steering lock ECU and steering lock motor are built into the steering lock actuator.
The steering lock ECU detects the lock/unlock position by means of the lock position switch of the steering lock motor.
The steering lock ECU receives lock/unlock command signals from the certification ECU and returns operation signals.
Since the steering lock ECU is not connected to CAN communication, responses to outside the steering lock system are made by the certification ECU via LIN communication.

item.ptxt: Malfunction in steering lock motor drive circuit
Both lock and unlock position detection sensors judged ON
LIN communication line wire harness and connector

atten4.ptxt: When using the tool with the IG OFF, connect the tool to the vehicle and repeatedly turn the courtesy switch of any door ON/OFF until communication between the tool and the vehicle starts (ON/OFF interval within 1.5 seconds).

test1.ptxt: Connect SST (TaSCAN) to DLC3 and turn the IG ON.
On the SST (TaSCAN) screen, select [Diagnosis] → [Vehicle Diagnosis/ALL Diag] or [System Diagnosis/Body], and check the diagnostic trouble codes for [System Name/Certification ECU].

specitem.ptxt: LIN communication malfunction code (B2785) is not output

atten4.ptxt: If a LIN communication malfunction code is output, inspect the large-scale body multiplex communication system (LIN). (see )
